notes.subject: הקר
notes.rationale: Bo-ASV/JPS ba re 'seldom' (ka nako e nnyane); KJV e re 'withdraw' (tlosa) — Seheberu se bolela go dira maoto a bodulo pherere.

notes.subject: ישבעך
notes.rationale: Pukwana ya JPS e re 'sated with thee' — motho a tlala ka go go lebelela, go swana le moukouri wa lenyalo; mo go saetšwe ka moomo go tlala ka wena.

translation: Dira gore maoto a gago a be a se gantsi legaeng ya ntlo ya mogwera wa gago, gore a se ke a tlala ka wena, gomme a go hloya.

tokens.gloss: go dira gore a se gantsi legaeng
